proof_read.attained_first_unit_eigenvector: Only finite nontrivial real inner-product space and symmetric operator. The primary Rayleigh maximum is attained on a compact unit sphere, and the Fermat/Lagrange identity gives an eigenvalue. Normalize the nonzero eigenvector; no eigenbasis premise.
proof_read.invariant_complement: q-perp is the orthogonal complement of span(q). Symmetry and Tq=a q give inner(q,Tx)=inner(Tq,x)=0. Restriction inherits symmetry directly. Unit q makes the complement dimension one smaller.
proof_read.actual_dimension_induction: Zero rank uses only an empty reindexed orthonormal basis. Successor recursively invokes ih on the actual invariant complement and builds vecCons(q,b). Orthonormality plus full cardinality proves spanning; the basis retains the original vectors. This is actual dimension induction, with no distinct eigenvalue hypothesis.
proof_read.matrix_domain: Hermitian real matrix is identified with its symmetric action in EuclideanSpace, then coordinate casting gives the printed matrix eigen-equations.
proof_read.arbitrary_repeated_eigenspace_basis: Given an arbitrary ONB of the whole eigenspace, construct a spectral ONB on its orthogonal complement by the proved induction; Sum.elim combines these with unchanged chosen vectors. Cross-orthogonality and dimension additivity prove a complete basis. No global eigenbasis is assumed.
proof_read.positive_dimension_nonuniqueness: The selected real-symmetric reconstruction theorem supplies orthogonal Q and diagonal data. -Q preserves both identities. If index type is nonempty and Q=-Q, all entries vanish, contradicting a diagonal entry of Q-transpose Q=I.
proof_read.zero_dimension: Actual Fin0 matrices are subsingletons. The induction and extension include zero; only nonuniqueness is qualified.
